overview.title: Overview
overview.hint: Scan first, then pick the skills you want to own.
overview.lead: Adopt → project → upgrade. This page only lists what needs deciding now.

next.title: Next up
next.broken: {n} projections are broken links — clients will not load them
next.conflict: {n} skills changed both locally and upstream — file-by-file merge needed
next.unmanaged: {n} skills on disk are not managed yet

library.title: My skills
library.none: No managed skills yet. Adopt some from Discover.
library.lead: One entity, many places: every client sees a link to it.
library.legend: Dots: filled = live, amber = shadowed, red = broken link, hollow = not scanned.

discover.title: Discover
discover.subtitle: These skills exist on disk but Heron does not manage them yet.
discover.nestedWarning: Nested suspects are reported only, never edited automatically (design D8).
discover.previewHint: Preview first: this step only reads. Files move after you confirm, and only after a backup.
discover.adoptedNothing: None of the {n} selected paths were adopted (they may have moved or changed). Scan again and retry.
discover.noSlug: Not recognised as a skill; will be skipped
discover.backupNote: A backup is taken before anything moves; a failure leaves the originals untouched.

sources.title: Sources & markets
sources.pasteUrl: Paste a git URL and press Enter

projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: A target is the directory a client actually reads; project targets only apply to that project.

upgrades.title: Updates
upgrades.lead: Three-way merge: local and upstream changes are both kept; whatever cannot merge waits for your decision, file by file.

doctor.title: Health
doctor.lead: Read-only checks: duplicates, broken links, nested suspects, lost sources. Nothing on disk is changed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.nativeScanOff: Off by default: nothing is written to unverified clients (D6)
settings.updateFailed: Update check failed (expected in local dev builds)
settings.lead: Theme, language, app updates and client capabilities — changes apply immediately.
settings.themeNote: The theme applies immediately and is remembered for next launch.

errors.E_GIT_MISSING: git was not found; please install it
errors.E_NETWORK: Network request failed; check your proxy and retry
errors.E_SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS: That address is ambiguous and needs your choice
errors.E_SLUG_CONFLICT: A skill with that name already exists
errors.E_REF_NOT_FOUND: Branch, tag or path not found
errors.E_DRIFTED: The destination was changed by something else; stopped
errors.E_NOT_MANAGED: That location is not managed by Heron
errors.E_MARKET_UNAVAILABLE: The market is unreachable right now

conflict.title: Resolve conflicts
conflict.hint: {n} files: decide each one; “Save and retry” commits your choices and re-runs the upgrade.

shell.pendingHint: {n} waiting: unadopted skills, upgradable skills and broken projections. Open the check-up.
shell.gitHint: Git fetches and diffs skill sources (this is not the app's version). Open Sources.
shell.gitMissingHint: Git not found: cloning and upgrading sources need it. Open Settings.
